name: content-strategy
description: Decide what content to make, fix or retire: what to do with each existing page and why, topics your company can write from its own evidence, a plan that fits your team's real hours, briefs a writer can work from, and lead-magnet plans for a topic cluster. It plans; it does not write the content or build campaigns.

interface.longDescription: Five connected skills for teams with limited hours. Decide what happens to existing pages (keep, update, merge, redirect, retire or leave alone), with the reason on every row and a list of what could not be checked. Build a topic map where every topic names the company's own evidence behind it, or is set aside as generic. Turn a list of ideas into a week-by-week plan that fits the team's hours, with a planning score and a not-now list. Write briefs a writer can work from, using the team's own evidence, and plan lead magnets with a stated reason for asking or not asking for an email. A publish date alone never decides a page's fate. It plans; it does not write the content.
defaultPrompt: Keep, update, merge or cut: /blog/ap-tips-2021 (40 visits), /blog/ap-automation-guide (2,100), /blog/ap-tips-2023 (35).
Demo goal, 1 writer 6h/wk. Topics: ROI guide (own data), customer story (own data), AP glossary (no own data). What fits this quarter?
Topic map for Northwind Ledger: AP automation for 50-500 staff firms, goal demo requests, we have 40 customer interviews.
